# The Python packages the workflows install, at exact versions; Dependabot
# keeps them current (.github/dependabot.yml). The packages these bring in
# aren't pinned, but pip takes only versions at least 7 days old
# (PIP_UPLOADED_PRIOR_TO in .github/workflows/jekyll-gh-pages.yml)

# Renders cv.yaml as the site's CV and its PDF
rendercv[full]==2.8
# Converts the site's WOFF2 fonts to TTF for the PDF
fonttools[woff]==4.66.1
# Draw the favicon and app icons from favicon.svg
resvg-py==0.5.0
pillow==12.3.0
